newsitem.title: USA: MAPCO to open Houston trading office.
newsitem.headline: MAPCO to open Houston trading office.

text.p: MAPCO Inc said an office will be established in Houston, Texas, for the company's supply and trading group, combining operations presently located in Tulsa and Memphis, Tenn.

"We are moving this part of our business into the heart of the oil, gas and petrochemical marketplace where a large number of our customers are located," explained Chief Operating Officer Robert Sachse.
Jim Teague, vice president of Supply and Trading, will lead the new Houston office, handling MAPCO's supply and trading activity in crude refined products, natural gas liquids and natural gas.
